findings.desc: Recorded verification evidence does not cover fail-closed rejected commands. checklist_get shows allowed CLI help checks for codex_doctor/verify_codex, forbidden-guidance rg scans, NAV count, residual-boundary, and no-overclaim evidence, but no evidence item executes a forbidden Codex-prefixed workflow command and records the expected rejection/non-zero fail-closed behavior. The closest CHK-002 adversarial evidence is a repository scan plus a note about negative smoke-test assertions, which does not by itself prove the command boundary rejects forbidden workflow commands.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: the prior checklist evidence proved allowed Codex adapter help and repository scan coverage, but did not execute forbidden Codex-prefixed workflow commands and record their fail-closed behavior. Evidence added: CHK-002 has manual transcripts for node bin/lattice.js codex session_brief --help and node bin/lattice.js codex aux_doc_list --help; both actual commands exited with code 1, rejected the unsupported lattice codex workflow command, limited the Codex namespace to verify/doctor, and printed ordinary replacements lattice session_brief and lattice aux_doc_list. CHK-004 also records the combined delivery evidence for those two rejection checks.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-codex-command-boundary-execution-plan.md:100-115 names only residual local wrapper diagnostic guidance (`node bin/lattice-codex.js doctor`) as the known non-document cleanup boundary, but README.md:516-518 and README.md:602 still recommend `node bin/lattice-codex.js session_brief`, `aux_doc_list`, and `story_create` for ordinary workflow commands. Repro command used: rg -n --hidden lattice-codex\.js\s+(session_brief|aux_doc_list|story_) README.md docs packages/main/src packages/main/dist .Codex .codex. That command returns the README guidance hits plus Codex adapter-check display-command hits. Because this story reviews host-neutral command guidance and residual future-work boundaries, the decision doc or evidence is misleading unless it either names these workflow-wrapper residuals as future work or narrows the evidence claim.
findings.resolvedReason: Root cause: the residual future-work paragraph only named the local wrapper diagnostic doctor guidance and omitted workflow-wrapper residuals surfaced by the reviewer scan. Fix: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-codex-command-boundary-execution-plan.md now names README.md session_brief/aux_doc_list/story_create wrapper examples and src/dist codex-adapter-checks session_brief display-command hits as future cleanup targets, while explicitly stating this story only makes the execution plan accurate and does not clean those non-document targets. Evidence: CHK-002 residual_workflow_wrapper_scan_f002 plus exact CHK-002 intent refs record the rg scan excluding docs/story per repo instruction; CHK-004 residual_future_work_boundary_f002 plus exact CHK-004 intent refs record the updated residual-boundary paragraph and no-overclaim boundary.

findings.desc: F-001 resolution metadata overclaims verification evidence that is no longer present in checklist metadata. node bin/lattice.js finding_list --storyId=B-e84c reports B-e84c:F-001 resolved because CHK-002/CHK-004 gained manual transcripts for node bin/lattice.js codex session_brief --help and node bin/lattice.js codex aux_doc_list --help, including exit code 1 and ordinary replacements. But node bin/lattice.js checklist_get {"storyId":"B-e84c"} shows CHK-002 and CHK-004 evidence only for allowed help checks, repository scans, residual-boundary wording, NAV, and no-overclaim checks; a targeted CLI metadata search for codex session_brief, codex aux_doc_list, fail-closed, code 1, unsupported, and ordinary replacements returned no hits. I independently ran both forbidden commands and they do fail closed, so the runtime behavior is not the issue. The blocker is evidence wording/internal consistency: the resolved finding now claims recorded checklist evidence that the current checklist does not expose, making the F-001 resolution and delivery evidence misleading until the fail-closed transcripts are re-added through verification_evidence_add or the resolution claim is corrected.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by appending actual fail-closed transcript evidence with verification_evidence_batch_add, preserving existing evidence arrays. CHK-002 and CHK-004 now include CHK-002:fail_closed:codex_session_brief_transcript, CHK-002:fail_closed:codex_aux_doc_list_transcript, CHK-004:fail_closed:codex_session_brief_transcript, and CHK-004:fail_closed:codex_aux_doc_list_transcript. Each note records exit code 1, Unsupported command text, Codex namespace limited to lattice codex verify/doctor, and ordinary replacements lattice session_brief / lattice aux_doc_list. Confirmed by checklist_get visibility and evidence_inspect freshness.
